long_biography.plain_text:
The cardiology department at Asklipieio Hospital in Voula benefited from Rana El Zein’s family giving. Alongside Riad Zein and Talal Zein, she supported the renovation of the department’s offices and the creation and full equipment of its hypertension clinic.

During the Covid-19 pandemic, the family also donated a machine from the United States to sterilise hospital wards. Their contributions formed part of a broader programme of privately funded improvements organised by cardiologist Athanasios Manolis. Donors supplied works and equipment directly, with projects approved by the hospital and Greek health authorities.
